'''Martyr's Plaza''' was a plaza, that was built by the [[Nazren]] and located in [[Ahdjok]], on [[Nizon]].

==History==
A 9-meter wide ornate stone dome was constructed in the center of the plaza and three large statues of ancient martyred heroes of the Nazren surrounded it. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] came to Nizon, they set up three defensive turrets between the statues and the plaza became the sight of some fighting during the [[Battle of Nizon]], when the Nazren rose up against the Empire.
